title: Unctuous Velvety French Chicken Coq Au Vin
description: A classic French dish featuring chicken, pears, and mushrooms in a rich, jammy sauce, cooked to perfection in a clay pot. This low-carb-friendly meal is perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chicken thighs with salt and black pepper.
In a large clay pot, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions to the pot and cook until they are softened and lightly browned.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the pot and cook until they are tender and lightly browned.
Add the sliced pears to the pot and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken thighs to the pot and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the red wine, chicken broth, tomato paste, and thyme to the pot, stirring to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the chicken and sauce for 25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is thick and jammy.
